title: Showcasing a little from my Game
author: Repulsive-Way3283
selftext:
Let me know what do you all think

There are some little details that I thought along the way and will implement them soon but most of the logic is working and I simulated 15 seasons without an issue.

This is a new save showing how game looks like.

comments.author: CautiousCarry4209
comments.body: Looks good, does not have that typical AI feel that I get from some games here. How long have you worked on it?

replies.author: Repulsive-Way3283
replies.body:
I tried to maintain that old school 2000-2010ish football managment style.
I started this in the last week of May , aooriximately when the football season ended. It started as small fun project but now got to where it is.

comments.author: davidslv
comments.body: Nice! I was thinking of bringing back Championship Manager. Very nice 👌

comments.author: work_in_marketing
comments.body:
Not a fan of the yellowish gpt tint but the rest look good.

FM will probably struggling moving forward with all the competition. Their value still lies in the DB though.

replies.author: Repulsive-Way3283
replies.body: Thanks. The game will have an editor mode where any player can edit their own database with emblems, images, names, attributes etc.
